input_contract: 200 immutable safetensors, 40 GENERATION JSON, 4 complete producer RUNs; fresh paired BF16 initial noise files byte equal; FP32 saved poststates BF16-exact
statistics: FP64 signed energy decomposition and effective velocity from state difference, not noise_pred
zero_denominator: null cosine; h must be finite positive
closure_tolerance: 64 * float64_epsilon * element_count * max(1, current, previous, increment, abs(twice_cross))
source_weighting: 20 source clusters; subject 0..9, background 10..19, each source equal; steps nested

external_launcher_required.coverage: entire subprocess including interpreter imports, preflight and computation
external_launcher_required.internal_watchdog: sampled peak RSS; RLIMIT_AS limits virtual address space and is more conservative than RSS
